No official_counts, participation_reports, ranked observations, runoff observations, or open_person observations activate count factors with eventG-scaled intensities.

factorization.math: If L(D|theta,kappa,G)=L(D|theta), then p(theta,kappa,G|D)=p(theta|D)p(kappa)prod_e Gamma(G_e|kappa,kappa). Integrating G and kappa leaves the same within-parent posterior for theta. This does not alter protected outer parent masses.
counterexamples: Any active official count Poisson likelihood uses G times base category rates; the observed-total branch has a coordinate-dependent Gamma density and Jacobian, so the prior-only simplification is invalid.
Participation-report NegativeBinomial means use event_intensity, hence G.
Ranked, runoff or open-person count observations use G-scaled Poisson intensities.
Ordinary poll rate-level additive epsilon breaks cancellation: log(G*r1+eps)-log(G*r2+eps) depends on G for eps>0.
